name: NRK Nyheter
description: Norway's public broadcaster: current news at natural speed, free to read.

name: NRK Urix
description: NRK's foreign news and explainers, a good place for world vocabulary.

name: NRK Ytring
description: Opinion pieces and columns in varied, demanding Norwegian.

name: Klar Tale
description: Norway's easy-to-read newspaper, with news written in simple language; some articles need a subscription.

name: VG
description: A large tabloid news site with news, sport and entertainment; premium articles need a subscription.

name: Dagbladet
description: News, sport and culture; articles marked Pluss need a subscription.

name: Aftenposten
description: A major newspaper with news, debate and culture; most reading needs a subscription.

name: Lær norsk nå
description: A podcast for intermediate learners on culture, politics and history, spoken clearly and slowly with dialect variety; a book and Patreon are optional extras.

name: Klar Tale audio edition
description: The weekly Klar Tale news read aloud in simple Norwegian, playable in the browser.

name: NRK Radio
description: Live radio, podcasts and audiobooks from NRK for listening to real Norwegian.

name: NorwegianClass101 on YouTube
description: The YouTube channel of NorwegianClass101 for learning Norwegian through video lessons.

name: One Minute Norwegian
description: Coffee Break Languages' free podcast of one-minute lessons on greetings, introductions, numbers and basic phrases.

name: Practice Norwegian
description: A podcast creator page with episodes for beginner to advanced learners; joining is free and paid membership adds exclusive posts.

name: Kjapt oppdatert
description: A five to seven minute weekday news podcast from NRK giving a quick overview of the day's news in Norwegian.

name: Hele historien
description: An NRK documentary podcast where people tell true stories of events that shaped Norway, in natural spoken Norwegian.

name: Store norske leksikon
description: Norway's free expert-written encyclopedia, good for clear reference reading on any topic.

name: NRK Super
description: Children's programmes with clear speech; NRK says it needs a child profile on NRK TV.

name: NRK Skole
description: NRK's school programmes and documentaries on many subjects, in clear Norwegian.

name: Wikipedia (Bokmål)
description: The Norwegian-language Wikipedia, with over 690,000 articles to read on topics you already like.

name: Nasjonalbiblioteket
description: The National Library's online collection of Norwegian books, newspapers and magazines; some items have access limits.

name: Project Gutenberg (Norwegian)
description: A list of free e-books in Norwegian, including works by Hamsun, Ibsen and Undset.

name: Wikikilden
description: The Norwegian Wikisource, a free library of about 15,000 public-domain texts such as novels, poetry and plays.

name: SKAM on NRK TV
description: The NRK TV page for the Norwegian teen drama SKAM, four seasons about life in upper secondary school.

name: LearnNoW (Norwegian on the Web)
description: A free beginner course from NTNU with 12 chapters of stories, audio, grammar, pronunciation and exercises.

name: NDLA
description: Free school learning resources for upper secondary subjects, with texts, films and podcasts in Norwegian.

name: Norskprøven (HK-dir)
description: The official page on the Norskprøven test of reading, listening, writing and speaking, with preparation sections for each part.

name: NorwegianClass101
description: Short audio and video Norwegian lessons with word lists and flashcards; free sign-up, with paid Premium tiers and optional tutoring.

name: Babbel Norwegian
description: A Norwegian course with native audio and review; the first lesson at every course level is free.

name: Memrise Norwegian
description: A scenario-based Norwegian course with native-speaker videos and AI conversations; free to start, with a paid Pro tier.

name: University of Bergen Norwegian courses
description: Norwegian courses at several levels for UiB students, employees, and immigrants or refugees with a residence permit; a placement test finds your level, and courses are free for UiB employees and their partners (prices for other groups are not stated).

name: Lingu
description: An accredited Norwegian school with online and classroom courses at A1 to C1, plus a free podcast (Norskpodden) and a free two-week trial of live lessons for A1, A2 and B1 learners.

name: NoW3 (Norwegian on the Web, level 3)
description: NTNU online course material for university-level learners (level 3 of Norwegian courses), with media texts, videos, grammar teaching and exercises; the page says it is still being developed.

name: Ordbøkene
description: The official Bokmål and Nynorsk dictionaries from Språkrådet and the University of Bergen, with spelling, forms and examples.

name: Wiktionary (Bokmål)
description: A free community dictionary with Norwegian definitions and word forms.

name: Lexin
description: Free Bokmål and Nynorsk dictionaries made for minority-language pupils, translating Norwegian into many languages.

name: Det Norske Akademis ordbok (NAOB)
description: The Norwegian Academy's large Norwegian-language dictionary, searchable online and free to use, funded partly by donations.

name: Glosbe Norwegian-English
description: A free community dictionary with Norwegian-English translations, example sentences from parallel texts and audio pronunciation.

name: Lexilogos: Norwegian dictionaries
description: A free portal that links to Norwegian dictionaries, translation tools, grammar guides and historical word references.

name: English Wiktionary: Norwegian Bokmål
description: The main category of Norwegian Bokmål entries in the free English Wiktionary, with sub-categories for lemmas, phrases and etymology.

name: Språkrådet
description: The Language Council's site on writing rules, usage questions, clear language and Norwegian language news.

name: Språkrådet: Skriveregler
description: Official guidance on commas, capital letters, compounds, numbers, punctuation and grammar terms.

name: Språkrådet: Språkhjelp
description: The Language Council's help pages on spelling, grammar, punctuation and usage, with links to Bokmålsordboka and Nynorskordboka.

name: grammatikk.com
description: A free Norwegian grammar site covering nouns, verbs, pronouns, adjectives, sentences and pronunciation, with some material in English.

name: Riksmålsforbundet: Grammatikk, en innføring
description: A free introduction to Norwegian grammar covering word classes, sentence structure and sentence analysis, written from the Riksmål standard, which differs in places from official Bokmål.

name: St. Olaf: Learning Norwegian online
description: A college Norwegian department's list of learning links, mostly free, including web exercises, grammar tutorials and pronunciation tools (it also lists some paid schools and programmes).

name: Wikipedia: Norwegian language
description: An English-language overview of Norwegian, its history, Bokmål and Nynorsk standards, sounds, dialects and grammar of nouns, adjectives, verbs and pronouns.

name: Språkbanken (National Library of Norway)
description: The National Library's language bank, a free catalogue of Norwegian datasets, corpora, lexicons and language tools.

name: Norsk aviskorpus
description: A download of Norwegian online newspaper text from 1998 to 2019, about 1.68 billion Bokmål words, free for non-commercial use.

name: N-gram (Norwegian Bokmål)
description: Word-sequence counts of 1 to 6 words from about 1.175 billion words of news text, with unigram frequency lists, released as public domain.

name: Norwegian Colossal Corpus (NCC)
description: A downloadable corpus of about 4.6 billion words (about 2.9 billion Bokmål and 181 million Nynorsk, plus Danish and English) from parliament records, books, government documents and newspapers; licences vary by source.

name: NB AI-Lab on Hugging Face
description: The National Library's AI lab shares Norwegian language models, speech models and datasets, plus demo apps.

name: Universal Dependencies: Norwegian Bokmål
description: A treebank of about 20,000 Bokmål sentences from news, blogs and nonfiction, annotated with word forms and grammatical structure.

name: Tatoeba: Norwegian Bokmål sentences
description: Over 18,000 community-written Bokmål example sentences with translations, readable without logging in.

name: Wiktionary: Norwegian frequency lists
description: A hub for Norwegian frequency lists, including the top 5,000 Bokmål words counted from subtitles, plus links to larger corpora.

name: NoTa-Oslo spoken corpus
description: A spoken Norwegian corpus of about 957,000 transcribed words from 166 Oslo speakers; searching needs a Feide or CLARIN login, while transcriptions are on GitHub.

name: Norwegian Wikipedia dumps
description: A file index of downloadable database and article-text dumps of the Norwegian (Bokmål) Wikipedia, updated regularly.

name: HelloTalk (Norwegian)
description: A language-exchange app where you chat, use voice rooms and practise Norwegian with native speakers; free exchange, with premium features offered.

name: italki Norwegian tutors
description: A marketplace of Norwegian tutors for one-to-one online lessons, with trial lesson and hourly prices shown per tutor.

name: LingQ (Norwegian)
description: A reading and listening library of Norwegian audio lessons with transcripts, spaced repetition and a community forum; free sign-up with paid tiers.

name: Clozemaster
description: A language-learning site that lists Norwegian Bokmål among its languages; it says the main features are free, with a Pro tier for power users.

name: Red Cross Norsktrening (Oslo)
description: Volunteer-led Norwegian conversation groups in Oslo, grouped by level, open to anyone 18 or older without registration.
